SALT SPRAY HAZE: a soft bright mist hanging in the air above the break, gently softening the rocks just beyond the foam
FINE SALT HAZE: fine salt haze drifting low over the water, softening the far rocks into pale quiet shapes
SPRAY VEIL: a gentle drifting veil of salt mist sitting above the foam, thinning gradually toward the drier sand
BRIGHT SALT MIST: a soft bright haze of salt spray hanging lightly in the air, blurring the middle distance into softness
HAZE ABOVE FOAM: a thin bright salt mist rising gently above the break, settling low and thinning as it drifts inland
DRIFTING SALT VEIL: fine salt haze drifting in a pale layer above the water's edge, softening shapes just beyond the shore
OFFSHORE FOG BANK: a low grey bank of sea fog sitting out over the water, the near sand and rock staying clear and sharp
FOG THINNING INLAND: sea fog lying thick offshore and thinning gradually, leaving the near sand open and clear
GREY FOG VEIL: a soft grey veil of sea fog swallowing the far headland, the closer ground remaining open to the air
LOW FOG LAYER: a low bank of sea fog resting close to the water's surface, thinning where it reaches the inner beach
FOG AT THE HEADLAND: soft grey sea fog settling around the far headland, the air near the dunes staying clean and open
CRISP SALT AIR: air washed clean and sharp after rain, carrying a bright clarity all the way to the distant rocks
COOL BRIGHT AIR: cool bright salt air sitting over the shore, every edge in the middle distance remaining crisp and defined
WARM STILL AIR: warm still salt air resting over the dry sand, holding every distant edge in sharp clear detail
CLEAN SHARP AIR: air rinsed clean and carrying a fine salt sharpness, the whole coastal layer feeling open and clear
BRIGHT CLEAR AIR: cool, clean, salt-bright air spread evenly over the shore, the far shapes staying crisp and readable
SAND STREAMING LOW: a thin skin of dry sand streaming low across the beach surface, hugging the ground in a pale moving layer
SAND SMOKING OFF DUNE: fine dry sand smoking gently off a dune crest, drifting low and settling back across the slope
LOW SAND SKIN: a thin pale skin of sand drifting low across the open beach, staying close to the surface as it moves
SAND DRIFT LAYER: dry sand drifting in a fine low layer across the beach, thinning and settling softly further inland
DRIZZLE CURTAIN: a soft grey curtain of drizzle hanging far off over the water, blurring the distant air into pale grey
FINE RAIN VEIL: fine rain dimpling the shallows and hanging as a soft pale veil across the nearer stretch of water
GREY DRIZZLE FAR OFF: a thin grey drizzle sitting far out over the water, softening the air in the distance to a pale wash
WARM SAND SHIMMER: warm air shimmering low over dry sand, a faint soft trembling just above the surface
SHIMMER OVER DRY SAND: a gentle warm shimmer rising from dry sand, lying low and soft above the open beach surface
